name: The Loch
summary: The Loch's waters fill the heart of Loch Modan, held back by the Stonewrought Dam. The lake is Khaz Modan's largest body of water and sustains the dwarven settlements around it.

sections.title: Heart of the Valley
sections.body: At the center of Loch Modan, The Loch spreads among the largest inland lakes in the known world. Only Lordamere Lake and Darrowmere Lake to the north rival its size. Local fishermen draw from its waters, while Thelsamar and nearby hunting lodges enjoy a peaceful setting along its shores. Beneath the calm surface, aggressive threshadons and freshwater beasts make swimming across perilous.

sections.title: The Stonewrought Barrier
sections.body: To the north, the Stonewrought Dam keeps The Loch in its tranquil state. The massive dwarven structure crosses a cleft in the mountains and prevents the lake from flooding into the Wetlands below. Its upkeep preserves the valley's ecosystem and helps keep Khaz Modan secure.

faq.answer: The Loch fills the center of the Loch Modan valley in Khaz Modan. This vast mountain lake is one of the world's largest freshwater bodies and shapes local dwarven life and the valley's geography.

faq.q: How does the lake stay full?
faq.answer: The Stonewrought Dam contains The Loch to the north. The towering dwarven structure holds back the water that would otherwise spill through the mountain pass into the low-lying Wetlands.

faq.q: Is it safe to swim in The Loch?
faq.answer: Swimming in The Loch can be dangerous. Predatory threshadons and snapping beasts in deeper waters often attack travelers who venture far from shore.

faq.q: How large is The Loch compared to other lakes?
faq.answer: The Loch is Khaz Modan's largest body of water and the third largest known lake in the Eastern Kingdoms. Only Lordamere Lake and Darrowmere Lake in Lordaeron are larger.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can take pride in The Loch, a centerpiece of Ironforge pride. Its waters and the Stonewrought Dam show how dwarven masonry can tame nature and sustain settlements such as Thelsamar.
As an Alliance traveler, you can follow The Loch's tranquil waters. They provide vital freshwater and trade routes between Ironforge's central valley and the surrounding outposts.
